facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('There are no modern conveniences on state forest lands such as dump stations, utility hook-ups, showers, or water') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29283 ('No Modern Amenities: ... no electric, water, sewer hook-ups, or dump stations on state forest land'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site on Blankley Road at the Sweet Root Trail intersection: a gravel and grass lot that holds 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents, with a picnic table. Back-in, max vehicle length 40 ft (site 50 x 35 ft, 40-ft driveway).

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29283 ('Max Vehicle Length: 40', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Grass', 'Driveway Length: 40', 'Site Length: 50', 'Site Width: 35', Description: 'Located on Blankley Road, Bedford at the Sweet Root Trail intersection. Gravel and grass parking lot that will hold 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents. Easy access but visible from roadway. Ideal for access to Sweet Root Natural Area. This site has a picnic table.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Permit and reservation required, online or by calling 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/buchanan/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29283 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in roadside site (CV014 Nester Lot, Chaneysville loop) with a 40-ft max vehicle length, reservation required (fcfs never), open year round. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
